origin.description: Point R_MAKEVARS_USER at a rewritten Makevars file.

arguments.name: _path
arguments.text: Existing Makevars file. The user file when omitted.

origin.details: An existing assignment for the same name is replaced. Other lines are kept. The assignment form is =, :=, ?=, or +=.
origin.value: The previous Makevars lines, or NULL when there was no file.
origin.example:
src <- tempfile()
writeLines("CFLAGS = -O2", src)
before <- Sys.getenv("R_MAKEVARS_USER")
lines <- local({
  local_makevars(CFLAGS = "-O3", .path = src)
  readLines(Sys.getenv("R_MAKEVARS_USER"))
})
c(lines, if (identical(Sys.getenv("R_MAKEVARS_USER"), before)) "restored" else "open")

translation.description: Point R_MAKEVARS_USER at a rewritten Makevars file.

arguments.name: _path
arguments.text: Existing Makevars file. The user file when omitted.

translation.details: An existing assignment for the same name is replaced. Other lines are kept. The assignment form is =, :=, ?=, or +=. code is a callable, and local_* is a context manager.
translation.value: The previous Makevars lines, or NULL when there was no file.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile
from withr import *

fd, src = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
with open(src, "w") as handle:
    handle.write("CFLAGS = -O2\n")
before = os.environ.get("R_MAKEVARS_USER")
with local_makevars(CFLAGS="-O3", _path=src):
    with open(os.environ["R_MAKEVARS_USER"]) as handle:
        lines = handle.read().splitlines()
after = os.environ.get("R_MAKEVARS_USER")
os.remove(src)
return lines + ["restored" if after == before else "open"]
